title: verify.rs: .iter().next() should be .iter().next() or .first() on SetOfVec
description: verify.rs line 291: md_attr.values.iter().next() — SetOfVec implements AsRef<[T]>, so md_attr.values.as_ref().first() would be slightly more idiomatic and self-documenting (reads as 'get the first value' rather than 'start an iterator and take the first item'). Not a correctness issue. Clippy may or may not flag this depending on the SetOfVec iter type.
close_reason: Won't fix: .iter().next() is correct and idiomatic; clippy does not flag it; .as_ref().first() is marginally different but adds no safety or clarity.
